question: What is the minimum age a person should be if he/she is willing to be appointed as the Governor of a state in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**35 years.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** minimum age a person** should be if he/she is willing to be appointed as the **Governor of a state** in India is** 35 years.**
 
• This is mentioned in **Article 157 **of the Indian Constitution which states that a person shall not be eligible for appointment as Governor unless he is a **citizen of India** and has completed the **age of 35 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Governor **is the **Constitutional Head of a state** in India and is appointed by the **President of India.**
 
• The Governor's term of office is** five years** but can be** terminated earlier** by the President.
 
• The Governor has many powers and functions such as** administering oaths and affirmations, summoning and proroguing the state legislature, giving assent to bills passed by the state legislature, and appointing judges of the state High Court.**
